structured.answer: I'd go with ג. It's the same S&P 500 group as א, but it also shows how much each track went up over 3 and 5 years, and that's what I wanted to see. On it I'd probably pick מנורה עוקב מדד S&P500: lowest fee (0.52%), about 13.8% a year over 3 years, and a name I know.

stuck.where: Top of the page, the three bullet points under the main heading
stuck.why: A wall of small text. I skipped it and had no idea what 'שלוש אפשרויות' meant until I saw the א/ב/ג headings

stuck.where: Option א, two numbers per row: 'מהחיסכון' and 'מההפקדות'
stuck.why: I didn't get why there are two fees. I just looked at the top one

stuck.why: The first row is 'עוקב מדדים - גמיש' with 55% מניות, mixed in with S&P and אשראי ואג"ח. Felt like a jumble, so I scrolled past
Some rows only say 'פחות מ־3 שנים' with no number (אלטשולר, אינפיניטי, ילין). I couldn't tell if that's bad or they're just new
מיטב shows 13.87% and מנורה 13.79%. They're almost the same, so I went with the cheaper fee

findings.what: The fee is only shown as a small percent. There's no shekel amount, so 0.52% and 0.71% both look like nothing to me
Every S&P row looks the same (99%/100%, same rings). Without the returns column I couldn't tell them apart and would have just closed the page
One mixed list where the top row is a 'גמיש' track with 55% מניות. It doesn't feel like it's about what I came for
Some rows have no return number ('פחות מ־3 שנים'), so they look worse or riskier next to the ones that do
Two fee numbers per row with no explanation of the difference
Lots of small text at the top before you reach anything useful
A small 'מומלץ' tag on א, but the option that actually helped me was ג
No button or next step for actually starting
